title: Kubernetes / Logs
description: Container logs and Kubernetes events from the cluster. Opens on the last 15 minutes because log queries over long ranges are slow.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Search values present in the selected time range (up to 1,000 suggestions).

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Search values present in the selected time range (up to 1,000 suggestions).

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: Choose a namespace, service and time range. Stream and severity start at All. Shows up to 1,000 matching lines; narrow the time range if needed. Open a row's log menu for details and surrounding logs.

targets.expr:
k8s.namespace.name:in(${namespace}) service.name:in(${service}) log.iostream:in(${stream})
| format if (severity_number:range[1, 4]) "trace" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[5, 8]) "debug" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[9, 12]) "info" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as level
| format if (level:="") "unknown" as level
| filter level:in(${level})

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Kubernetes events in the chosen namespaces: scheduling, image pulls, mounts, probe failures and restarts. Severity applies; Service and Stream do not. Each line is the reason, the object, then the message; the count and reporter are in the row's details.

targets.expr:
{service.name="kubernetes-events"} k8s.namespace.name:in(${namespace})
| format if (severity_number:range[1, 4]) "trace" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[5, 8]) "debug" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[9, 12]) "info" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as level
| format if (severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as level
| format if (level:="") "unknown" as level
| filter level:in(${level})
| format "<k8s.event.reason> <k8s.object.kind>/<k8s.object.name>: <_msg>" as _msg
